summary: Roll7's precision skateboarding series, from twitchy pixel-art Vita and PC games through the brighter, more accessible OlliOlli World.

entries.title: OlliOlli
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release; OlliOlli: Switch Stance is a convenient portable collection

emulation.notes: Run the Windows release natively; Vita/PS3/Wii U/3DS versions can be preserved through their respective hardware or emulation for platform history.

primary.why: OlliOlli began on PlayStation Vita in January 2014, then came to Windows, OS X, Linux, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, Android, Nintendo 3DS, Wii U, Xbox One, and Switch through the later OlliOlli: Switch Stance collection. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most accessible single-game route for the original precision skateboarding game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version natively; use Vita for historical handheld context or Switch Stance for portable access to the first two games together.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Switch release is a collection of the first two games rather than a separate remaster with exclusive content.

entries.title: OlliOlli2: Welcome to Olliwood
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release; OlliOlli: Switch Stance is a convenient portable collection

emulation.notes: Run the Windows release natively; preserve Vita/PS4/Xbox/Switch routes for platform-history comparisons if desired.

primary.why: OlliOlli2: Welcome to Olliwood released first for PlayStation 4 and PlayStation Vita in March 2015, then came to Windows, OS X, Linux, Android, Xbox One as XL Edition, and Nintendo Switch through the Switch Stance collection. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most straightforward preservation route for the sequel.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version natively; use PlayStation Vita for the original handheld context, Xbox One for XL Edition history, or Switch Stance for a portable bundle of the first two games.

entries.remaster_caveats: Xbox One's XL Edition and Switch Stance are port/collection routes, not sourced content-superior remasters.

entries.title: OlliOlli World
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with VOID Riders and Finding the Flowzone DLC where owned

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows with both expansions installed if owned.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings with DLC

primary.version: PC release with VOID Riders and Finding the Flowzone DLC where owned
primary.why: OlliOlli World released for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S in February 2022, then added the VOID Riders and Finding the Flowzone expansions later in 2022. Windows with both expansions installed is the highest-fidelity and most complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings with VOID Riders and Finding the Flowzone installed if owned; use PS5/Xbox Series X/S as strong console alternatives and Switch only for portable play.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster; publishing rights changed after Private Division/Roll7 corporate changes, so storefront availability should be rechecked when buying.
